claim: The default service limit for the number of Snowball Edge devices you can have at one time is 1 per account, per AWS Region; to increase the limit or create a cluster job, contact AWS Support.

evidence.quote: The default service limit for the number of Snowball Edge Edge devices you can have at one time is 1 per account, per AWS Region. If you want to increase your service limit or create a cluster job, contact [AWS Support](https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/).
